simple.meaning: תַּאֲנָה (taʼănâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “an opportunity or (subjectively) purpose.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תַּאֲנָה (H8385) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Judges 14:4, with occurrences in Judges, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּאֲנָה (H8385) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תַּאֲנָה (H8385) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תַּאֲנָה (taʼănâh) / H8385 is traced through Judges 14:4, Jeremiah 2:24 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
